top_signals.title: Washburn & Doughty Delivers Tug to McAllister
top_signals.summary: McAllister Towing received the tug Mary McAllister from Washburn & Doughty Associates, Inc. in Maine. Mary McAllister is the sixth in a seven-tug series of American Bureau of Shipping-classed and certified 84-metric-ton bollard pull, low-emission tractor tugs.

top_signals.title: Reliance Plans $1 Billion Securitization Deal in Borrowing Push
top_signals.summary: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance Group is planning to raise as much as 100 billion rupees ($1 billion) through asset-backed securities, according to people familiar with the matter, in what may be one of the largest such deals in India this year.
